how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored byte for byte and its sha256 re-checked (X14/X15/F4's convention, unchanged): `before` is the shipped source the row was run against and `after` is the text that replaced it. Rows 1-7 were run by a script that verifies the restore; rows 8-11 edit `.github/workflows/ci.yml` the same way. Run on maintainer-mac-1 overnight 31 Oct/1 Nov 2026, lease F8-wbpsf, code tree 6d317aac80fd. The two device-side proofs at the end are not mutations: they are the shipped code run in a configuration that must fail, which is what the brief asks of a premise guard.
